Responsabilita - Executing work in periodic maintenance at the F/A-18 of the Swiss Air Force - Implementation of change and control orders on the aircraft - Unplanned repairs on F/A-18 - Participation in internal courses Requisiti - Complete mechanical basic training - Embossed technical talent - Good knowledge of English (B2) - Reliable and clean operation and great willingness to take responsibility are prerequisites - Reliable, team-capable and dedicated personality that has endurance and flexibility - Ready for shift work (2 shifts Monday – Friday) Vantaggi Your benefits Your well-being is our heart.
